intro: What changed in the current version, in plain words. Only gameplay changes are listed; cosmetic and store changes are left out. Each version links to the wiki's full notes.

changes.text: Fixed the Halloween crash on Another Brick (decorative pigeons).

versions.headline: Bug fixes, including the S.P.I.D.E.R. Monkey.

changes.text: Single Out can no longer one-shot bosses under certain conditions.

versions.headline: Bug fixes for Skywarden, Supply Drop and cash counters.

changes.text: Its ability can skip a boss skull again even if the S.P.I.D.E.R. Monkey already skipped one.
Elite Sniper's ammo crate buff now ends as soon as the tower is sold.
Storm's Pulse now crosspaths correctly with every other Skywarden upgrade.
Comanche Defense's mini Comanches no longer stop other towers from targeting Bloons.
Ember no longer lasts forever through its cooldown.
Corrosive Glue and Super Glue now show a damage counter.

versions.headline: Sniper and S.P.I.D.E.R. Monkey fixes, and Rubber to Gold and Bloon Trap exploit fixes.

changes.text: Big nerf: its bullets' bonus damage to bosses dropped from +15,500 to +500, and its shrapnel's pierce from 100 to 1.
Supply Drop (x-4-x) bullets are Sharp again, so they can't pop Lead unless the Sniper also has Full Metal Jacket (1-4-x).
Elite Defender's life-loss speed boost is back to 4× (v57.0 had cut it to 2×).
Rubber to Gold no longer makes money in CHIMPS, and its bonus now drops with the late-game cash-per-pop reduction.
Bloon Trap no longer makes extra money in Deflation or from regrown Regrow Bloons (the same fix applies to Obyn's Wall of Trees).
Aerial Attunement buffs heroes of any level again; Wind Weaver's combo now affects BADs; Thunder's Decree can be reused after 9 seconds instead of 15.
Ancestral Might casts properly again.

versions.headline: S.P.I.D.E.R. Monkey (Sniper Paragon), the Advanced map Ship Capture, a Paragon power rework and a new Insta Monkey system.

changes.text: New Sniper Paragon: the S.P.I.D.E.R. Monkey.

Paragon power rework: extra upgrade tiers no longer count; the cash cap rose from 60,000 to 80,000 power and the pops/income cap from 90,000 to 125,000. Degree 100 is now possible without totems or co-op.
New Advanced map: Ship Capture.
Lost Crevasse's lanes were simplified: all of them now cross the middle and none slow down.
Crossbow and Sharp Shooter gained pierce and crit damage; Crossbow Master now fires two bolts side by side at half the attack rate.
Bomb Blitz's passive now triggers only once per round; frag pierce on several crosspaths was retuned.
Glue Splatter is cheaper ($970 → $650) and Glue Strike pricier ($4,000 → $4,500); Stickier Glue and the MOAB Glue line hold MOAB-class for less time.
Supply Drop can now switch to an Ammo Drop that powers up shrapnel for a few shots (Elite Sniper shares it with two nearby Snipers).
Sun Temple's Storm Blast (with enough Magic sacrifices) can now hit and strip Camo, and DDTs with bigger sacrifices.

Big rebalance: path 1 is cheaper at tiers 3–4 with a smaller, capped range buff; Thundering Arc now deals Plasma damage (pops Lead); Galvanic Conduit and Thunder's Decree cost more; Winter's Mercy hits harder.
Mega Massive Munitions Factory's mini spikes deal more MOAB damage (+100 → +200).
Call to Arms and Homeland Defense can no longer be activated while their buff is already active.
Bloon Trap now pays pop cash immediately; only its bonus cash waits for collection.
MOAB Shove no longer affects ZOMGs.
From level 4 he has a Focus toggle: more range and accurate shots at a slower rate.
Reworked: the water pierce buff comes at level 4, Naval Tactics starts weaker but covers all water towers from level 8 and adds damage from level 14.
Blastapopoulos: bottom-path Skywardens now cool its heat. Boss Rush island requirements and some boss stats were adjusted.
Every Monkey Knowledge point can now be turned off on its own; flat-discount Knowledge now works correctly outside Medium.
